name: peek-before-eradicate
description: G7 (John's case): cart runs ahead of eradicate along eradicate's own way into the Apartments corridor to where the recording has Lokier headshot eradicate at 12.75 s (about 10 s; cart's own recording is still in Back Alley then, 7 s from the corridor), and on west toward the window into Lokier's line from Truck (X1d: on the 2020 mesh that line reaches only x -1450 or so into the Apartments, so he is in it at 12.6 s; on CS2's, already at 10.7 s at eradicate's spot), where he stops. cart never fires. He is off script for Lokier, who is scoped on that corridor, so Lokier goes LIVE and shoots at him within a human reaction time; the scheduled window encounter is over. The survivors carry on and rejoin their recording where it still makes sense.
